title: Bloq Quantum Launches Bloq Maya AI Agent to Streamline Enterprise Quantum Algorithm Development - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Bloq Quantum commercially launched Bloq Maya, an agentic AI assistant that turns high-level use-case requirements into quantum code, parameterized circuits and QUBO models inside its low-code workspace, targeting enterprise R&D in finance, logistics and pharma.

insights.claim: Bloq Quantum has commercially launched Bloq Maya, an agentic AI assistant that automates circuit design, algorithm formulation, and code generation for enterprise quantum development.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: AI-agent layers are emerging as the abstraction that lowers the quantum skills barrier; watch adoption versus incumbent SDK vendors.

insights.claim: Bloq Maya provides a conversational interface that converts high-level use-case requirements into executable quantum code, parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs), and QUBO mathematical models, and automates environment configuration.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Automating the problem-to-QUBO translation targets the main labor bottleneck in applied quantum optimization.

insights.claim: Bloq Quantum positions the tool to cut development timelines for corporate R&D teams in financial risk modeling, portfolio optimization, logistics, and pharmaceutical simulations.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Named target verticals indicate where enterprise quantum pilots are being sold; the article gives no customer or timeline-reduction data.

insights.claim: The platform includes a low-code library of over 15 pre-built research-grade quantum algorithms, including QKAN, PQK, QEMCMC, and QSVM, plus a drag-and-drop Visual Circuit Studio and an Experiments module for benchmarking against classical and quantum solvers.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A built-in classical-versus-quantum benchmarking module speaks directly to the enterprise question of whether quantum adds value.

insights.claim: Bloq's workspace offers hardware-agnostic write-once deployment across cloud simulators and physical QPUs, including IBM Quantum and AWS Braket.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Software layers that abstract away QPU vendors shift value from hardware makers to the workflow owner.

insights.claim: Bloq Maya builds on Bloq Quantum's earlier launch of its unified low-code algorithm platform and its workforce and education alliances, expanding its enterprise software ecosystem.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Shows a vendor layering platform, agent, and training to lock in enterprise users.
